messages:
Maya P: Heads up — planning a tiny opt-in header shim to help console attribution while we complete the routing header rollout. Goal: non-breaking, no raw tenant in logs.

Liam K: ok, what's the header look like? keep it compact.

Maya P: propose:
X-RW-ROUTE: svc=payments;rh=0x9f
X-RW-Q: b=default;t=sha256:abcd1234 (salted hash, truncated)
Emit only when client flag enabled.

Renee H: console will accept both new and legacy keys for 30 days. We'll store hash as tenant_h and never show raw tenant. Need a note about salt rotation.

Noah S: in Python/TS/Go SDKs we'll add client.enable_route_shim (default false). Also add redaction in logging util for X-RW-Q/X-RW-ROUTE.

Liam K: add a migration metric route.header.version and header_version tag in samples. Also canary at 1% first.

Maya P: rollout plan: flags released -> staging flips -> 1% canary (obs watches) -> opt-in for new installs after 7 days -> legacy mapping stays for 30 days.

obs-bot: created alert 'rw_shim_cleartext_tenant' -> #devex-oncall.

sdk-bot: created ticket RW-7001 "route shim: SDK opt-in + console mapping".

Maya P: thanks — please include redaction unit tests and a 1-paragraph migration playbook in the PR. Tag me.
